articles.title: Spider-Man Takes a Bullet for a Friend — Just Like in the Comics!
articles.summary: In the new Spider-Man movie, Peter Parker jumps in front of a bullet meant for Jean Grey. It's a scary moment that mirrors his death in an older comic book series. But don't worry — this time, he survives with Jean's help.

articles.title: Rain Can't Stop the Rock: Smashing Pumpkins and Charli XCX Light Up Lollapalooza!
articles.summary: At Lollapalooza in Chicago, Smashing Pumpkins brought out surprise guests Yungblud and Olivia Rodrigo, while Charli XCX kicked off her new tour with a dance party. Even steady rain didn't stop the massive crowds from having a blast.

articles.title: A Tiny Silver Amulet Found in a Grave Could Rewrite Christian History!
articles.summary: Archaeologists in Germany found a 1,800-year-old silver amulet with a secret message inside. It's the oldest evidence of Christianity north of the Alps, pushing back the known history by at least 50 years. The man wore it even though being Christian was dangerous back then.
